Eastern Roman emperor from 527 to 565, who tried to restore the Roman Empire of old. A peasant's son from the Balkans, he rose through his uncle Justin I, a soldier who became emperor. He married the former actress Theodora, his close partner in power.

  • He survived the Nika riots of 532 and rebuilt the burned city, crowned by Hagia Sophia.
  • His lawyers gathered Roman law into the Corpus Juris Civilis, the basis of law in much of Europe.
  • His general Belisarius took North Africa in the Vandalic War, and a long Gothic War won back Italy.
  • He fought and paid off the Sasanian Persians in the east.

The cost was huge. The plague of 541 struck in the middle of his wars, and he caught it himself. Taxes were heavy and Italy was left in ruins. He also pressed his idea of one church, closing pagan schools and calling a council in 553. Procopius praised him in public and attacked him in secret.
